minutes.headline: Committee reorganized with officers and assignments, and began a plan for Turkey Hill repairs, with no budget decisions.
minutes.summary: The committee swore in new members, re-elected its chair and vice chair, chose a secretary, and assigned liaison seats. It gave initial approval to a Costa Rica trip and final approval to a Galapagos trip, approved a personnel report and a calendar amendment, and tabled an extended-day handbook change. A long discussion of a draft Turkey Hill Elementary facility improvement plan ended with agreement to invite a town official to a working meeting.

public_comment.topic: No hands raised at the opening public comment.
Opposed funding the TCP renovation in the municipal hybrid model over a Turkey Hill renovation; said TCP work should be done gradually through the capital plan.
A speaker congratulated the new member and praised school sports, music and theater programs and the people who support them.

what_happened.line: The committee began a long discussion of a draft Turkey Hill Elementary facility improvement plan and ended with no resolution, agreeing to invite a town official to a working meeting.
Members elected a chair, vice chair and secretary by roll call, and approved the subcommittee appointments.
The committee gave initial approval to a Costa Rica trip and final approval to a Galapagos trip, both by voice vote.
The committee approved the personnel report and an amended school calendar, and tabled an extended day handbook amendment to the next meeting for feedback.
The committee authorized student activity funds for the four schools and continued all existing policies, both by roll call.

why_it_matters: The Turkey Hill repair plan is still a draft with no funding vote, so any capital plan contribution or town spending for the school would reach residents later, through the town's budget and meetings.
Because the extended day program pays for itself through fees, the tabled handbook change and any attendance shifts could mean different rates for families who use it.
watch_next: The next meeting, where the extended day handbook amendment returns for a vote after feedback.
A working meeting on the Turkey Hill plan, with the aim of finishing the document by the end of June.
